The description includes the 2016 value (47.421) as part of a continuous drop. However, the chart shows an increase from 46.466 in 2015 to 47.421 in 2016.

This phrase follows a description of an increase in 2017 ("се повишава до 65.018 хил. лв.") and fails to state that the value then decreases to 62.504 in 2018. This misrepresents the trend between 2017 and 2018.
